attBesluta.text: Ordered these cabinet jacks because we are putting in an IKEA kitchen. They work great and are a big help in all sorts of situations. I had to prep a concrete block wall and used these cabinet jacks to brace up some wood that was glued up to the concrete. All in all a big help.

Ottime aste, ben progettate, efficienti e solide quanto basta per sostenere ognuna ben 70 kg come da manuale. Mi piacerebbe sapere pero’ a che serve una barretta di metallo pendula assieme ad una graffetta accanto situata vicino al pad superiore, non c’è scritto nel manuale. In più non vedo se non erro accessori di ricambio per queste aste, come i pads che possono col tempo deteriorarsi o spaccarsi, perni, maniglie, etc.
I received mine damage and they replaced it very quickly

I bought these pole jacks for a job I had they arrived quickly. I had some 16 foot long faux beams to hang in a ceiling and no one to help me hold them up and these pole jacks worked like a dream, I wish I would've ordered a few more

Great quality, easy to install, very sturdy! My cats love it!

Very nice! If you have a small dog. Beautiful and quality is very good, I truly like it! But to put it at the wall it doesn’t feel safe, it’s not so firm, better to buy a bigger one and make a big square.

Tube bender bends well. Accuracy is difficult due to the poorly placed stickers. A few hacksaw marks fixed this problem in a flash. Cheap and easy to use. A real bargain for the few times I will ever use it. Recommend this tool at this price.
Ca fait le taf, manque juste un peu de précision, absence de diamètre du cintre pour calcul du cintrage, mais pas grave... pour le prix c'est très bien
